subject: Important Update: Your Flight Itinerary
body: Dear [Name], We would like to inform you about a change in your flight itinerary. Due to unforeseen circumstances, your connecting flight has been rescheduled. Your new flight details are as follows: Departure: [Date & Time] Arrival: [Date & Time] Please review the attached document for more information. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Best regards, The Airline Team
